html:
The Totonac are an Indigenous people of the Gulf coast and nearby mountains of Mexico, in northern Veracruz and Puebla. Their language belongs to the small Totonacan family.

The great city of El Tajín, with its Pyramid of the Niches, rose in their region in the centuries before 1200, though who built it is debated. By 1500 the Totonac towns paid heavy tribute to the Aztec Triple Alliance. In 1519 their capital, Cempoala, became the first ally of Hernán Cortés, and thousands of Totonac marched with him against the Aztecs. Disease then struck them hard.

The region around Papantla grows vanilla, a plant the Totonac were among the first to cultivate. They also keep the Dance of the Flyers, in which men spin down from a tall pole on ropes.
sum: The Totonac are an Indigenous people of the Gulf coast and nearby mountains of Mexico, in northern Veracruz and Puebla. Their language belongs to the small Totonacan family.
